title: Publication-derived input reconstruction for the 2013 April 11 M-FLAMPA mean-free-path sensitivity run
scientific_use: The reported values define the closest defensible reconstruction of Zhao et al. Figure 7. They are comparison metadata, not a complete SWMF runtime configuration.

publication.title: Solar Wind with Field Lines and Energetic Particles (SOFIE) Model: Application to Historical Solar Energetic Particle Events

background_solar_wind.magnetogram_selection: hourly magnetogram measured immediately before the flare eruption
background_solar_wind.poynting_flux_treatment: varied to obtain the best comparison with near-Earth observations

cme.parameter_derivation: derived from the GONG magnetogram and observed CME speed

particle_transport.equation: Parker diffusion equation on time-evolving Lagrangian magnetic field lines
particle_transport.shock_detection: sudden jump of solar-wind velocity along a field line
particle_transport.near_shock_diffusion: derived from total Alfven-wave intensity in AWSoM-R using a Kolmogorov spectral index of -5/3

particle_injection.normalization: Equation (1), using local AWSoM-R proton number density and temperature

assumptions_requiring_review: The publication does not identify the sample field line used in Figure 7; an Earth-connected line must not be assumed equivalent without author data or a documented connectivity match.
The Figure 7 horizontal-axis origin is calibrated graphically and is not supplied as a numerical author table.
The three mean-free-path calculations are treated as differing only in their far-upstream constant mean free path, as stated in the sensitivity discussion.
The published integral channel is treated as an ideal greater-than-10-MeV model integral, not as a folded GOES instrument response.

controlled_reconstruction.purpose: Run the linked srcSEP focused-transport kernel using only reported mean-free-path sensitivity plus explicit fixed assumptions for unpublished event state.
controlled_reconstruction.source_profile: sum of independent exponential release clocks
controlled_reconstruction.comparison_normalization: unit peak independently for each model and reference series
controlled_reconstruction.scientific_label: publication-informed controlled benchmark; not exact 2013-04-11 event reproduction

missing_required_inputs: Exact GONG magnetogram product name, timestamp, map bytes, and preprocessing operations used by the run
Event-specific AWSoM-R Poynting-flux and Alfven-wave correlation-length values
Complete EEGGL Gibson-Low parameter set and any manual orientation or placement adjustments
SWMF, AWSoM-R, EEGGL, and M-FLAMPA source revisions and build options
Complete SWMF PARAM files, boundary conditions, solver controls, and restart state
SC/IH mesh hierarchy, adaptive-refinement state, and numerical time-step controls
M-FLAMPA momentum grid, spatial discretization, time integrator settings, and boundary conditions
Coordinates or persistent identifier of the sample magnetic field line used for Figure 7
Exact author-produced numerical time series underlying Figure 7
completion_rule: This is the only XM02 input reconstruction. Retain reproduction_status=partial until the missing run-defining artifacts are obtained from the authors; preserve all controlled srcSEP substitutions in input.json and run provenance rather than creating an alternate runner input.
